dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Datasets used for training functional and surface area normative models, and for benchmarking tasks (COBRE, UMich, HCP-YA).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Datasets included the Human Connectome Project (young adult) study, the University of Michigan schizophrenia study, and the Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE)... Many sites were pulled from publicly available datasets including ABCD, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, NKI-RS, OpenNeuro, PNC, and UKBiobank.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: study_1/Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Methods / Dataset selection and scanner parameters, Paragraph 1; Appendix 1 / Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling, Paragraph 1

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Datasets were used either to train/test the normative models (80/20 split) or as transfer sets for benchmarking (COBRE, UMich, HCP-YA regression).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Training and testing datasets (80/20) were created... We leverage several datasets for the benchmarking tasks, the Human Connectome Project Young Adult study (HCP)... The Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE)... and the University of Michigan SchizGaze (UMich)... HCP was included in the initial training (half of the sample was held out in the test set), while the UMich and COBRE datasets were not included in the training and can be considered as examples of transfer to new, unseen sites.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Methods / Dataset selection and scanner parameters, Paragraph 1; Methods / Normative model formulation, Paragraph 2; Appendix 1 / Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling, Paragraph 1

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Counts derived from Supplementary Files 1 and 2. Functional model train/test split is explicitly provided. Surface area model lists N per site without split. Cortical thickness model N is cited from text.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: Data from 40 sites were combined to create the initial full sample... approx. N=22,000 [functional]... For the structural data, we used a publicly shared repository of pre-trained normative models that were estimated on approximately 58,000 subjects... Normative models of surface area were also added... [Supp 2 lists approx 43k]
